chapters.title: The Loose Mooring
chapters.blurb: Dusk fog climbs uphill from Reed Lock as the dead cross the lower sluice gates.

scene.title: The Bell That Did Not Toll

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: For three hundred winters, the great bronze Vesper Bell rang at dusk across Alderreach — sealing the river locks, the kilns, the mines, and the old Reliquary beneath the hills. Tonight, the sun sank in dead silence.

cues.speaker: Elion
cues.text: Not a single chime, Guy. And look at the canal — the fog is climbing uphill against the wind.

cues.speaker: Guy
cues.text: The mooring rope just snapped on the far bank. Something is crossing the sluice gates.

cues.speaker: Chruna
cues.text: Good. Whatever crawled out of the mud gets sharp iron instead of prayer.

chapters.title: Cold Fire
chapters.blurb: Follow the smoke to Split Kiln where goblin scavengers pry ward-plates off the furnaces.

cues.speaker: Elion
cues.text: The lock ward did not crack from age. See these gouges? Someone pried the brass plate loose with an iron bar.

cues.speaker: Chruna
cues.text: Then the bell wasn't an accident either. I'll sprint up the ridge road to Bell Court — you two follow the smoke from Split Kiln.

cues.speaker: Guy
cues.text: The furnaces are half dead, and those aren't kiln-hands hiding behind the brick stacks. Stay close, Elion.

chapters.title: The Stolen Clapper
chapters.blurb: Curogana uncovers the severed bell chain in Bell Court while raiders swarm the side gate.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: High above the mist-choked valley, beneath the vaulted arches of Bell Court, Curogana waited by an empty iron chain.

cues.speaker: Curogana
cues.text: The bronze is intact, Elion — someone cut the silver clapper clean out of its throat. And whoever hauled it away tracked white mine-chalk across every step.

cues.speaker: Chruna
cues.text: Save the tracking. The goblin rear-guard is still looting the side gate — let's ask them where they ran.

chapters.title: Hollow Watch
chapters.blurb: Empty ceremonial armor marches out of Lantern Mine behind Mara's defensive line.

cues.speaker: Mara
cues.text: You're from Bell Court? Keep behind the lamp posts. The miners fled an hour ago — not from goblins, from the gallery itself.

cues.speaker: Curogana
cues.text: Feel that hum in the stone? Those aren't soldiers in that plate armor. Something deep under the seam is wearing empty iron like a gauntlet.

cues.speaker: Chruna
cues.text: Empty iron rings louder when you split it. Mara — take the right flank.

chapters.title: The Scholar's Key
chapters.blurb: Mara and Ilyra storm the Forged Vault where terrified goblins barricaded the iron gate.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: While the others cleared the upper ore gallery, Mara and the young scholar Ilyra climbed the cliff trail to the Forged Vault — where the goblin warband had bolted the iron doors from within.

cues.speaker: Ilyra
cues.text: Mara, look at these panic marks on the lintel. The goblins didn't hoard the bell-clapper for treasure — they were terrified of what woke beneath the mine!

cues.speaker: Mara
cues.text: Scared thieves still shoot straight. Stay behind my shield, Ilyra, and let's see what's left inside.

chapters.title: The Price of Silence
chapters.blurb: Ilyra deciphers the founder's charter — cut off the undead trail at the upper canal weir.

cues.speaker: Ilyra
cues.text: The clapper is gone — the goblins dumped it down the upper sluice to buy their lives! And this founder's charter explains why: the bell's silver was forged from the Reliquary seal itself. Carry it back to the tomb, and the old ward unravels.

cues.speaker: Curogana
cues.text: So the dead didn't wake by accident. They whispered to greedy hands and called their own key home.

cues.speaker: Elion
cues.text: Then we cut off their trail at the upper weir before the current drags the silver all the way under the mountain.

chapters.title: Under the Loadstone
chapters.blurb: Break the iron vanguard under the glowing loadstone to open the breach to the Reliquary.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: Deep beneath Lantern Mine, where the ancient loadstone hums like a struck chord, five silent suits of iron stood sentinel before the cracked breach to the Reliquary.

cues.speaker: Mara
cues.text: The Reliquary arch lies right behind that steel wall, Elion. If we smash this vanguard, Guy and the others get a clean path straight to the altar.

cues.speaker: Ilyra
cues.text: My wards are ready. Let's break the iron and open the road.

chapters.title: The Sealed Reliquary
chapters.blurb: Four Level-3 heroes stand shoulder to shoulder inside the Reliquary to reclaim the silver clapper before dawn.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: Through the shattered breach lies the Reliquary Crypt, sealed since the founding of Alderreach. Upon the cold altar rests the stolen silver clapper — and beside it rise the ancient lords of ash.

cues.speaker: Guy
cues.text: Four of us, shoulder to shoulder. One last room before sunrise.

cues.speaker: Curogana
cues.text: Ancient wrappings burn fast. Let's remind them what living fire feels like.

cues.speaker: Elion
cues.text: Hold nothing back. Dawn is waiting on that bell!

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: When the last ash settled in the Reliquary, the six climbed the belfry stairs together with the silver clapper bound in cloth. Elion swung the chain home — and across Reed Lock, Split Kiln, and Lantern Mine, one clear golden note rang out into the morning sun.

cues.speaker: Mara
cues.text: Three hundred years, and still not a crack in the bronze.

cues.speaker: Elion
cues.text: And if the valley ever falls quiet again... Alderreach knows who will answer.
